subject: POC burn-in credit supplement — EdgeCraft latency validation
messages:
From: Maya Patel <maya@edgecraft.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: burn-in credit supplement for POC latency run

Hi Jonas —

Thanks again for the quick demo earlier this week. We want to run a controlled burn-in to validate P95 latency under sustained load for our integration. High level:
- Goal: validate 6-hour sustained window at ~10k RPS (peak soak + ramp)
- Target latency: p95 < 120ms for completion-time tokens
- Why: this is a gating metric for our production cutover (reliability and cost projections)

Can Redwood provision a short-term credit supplement and extend our trial quota for this run? We estimate the test will consume roughly 750k–1.1M tokens depending on prompt size and caching behavior — see attached brief (edgecraft-poc-plan.pdf) and an early quota calc (quota_calc.xlsx).

Immediate ask: 6 hours of capacity coverage and a temporary credit top-up to cover the testing window (ideally applied to deal RDW-5421 so we can measure post-run usage).

Would appreciate a quick yes/no and any timing constraints (we're aiming to run the night of Nov 23 PST).

Thanks,
Maya
Maya Patel
Head of Platform, EdgeCraft AI
ops@edgecraft.ai

Attachments: edgecraft-poc-plan.pdf (application/pdf), quota_calc.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya@edgecraft.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: burn-in credit supplement for POC latency run

Hi Maya —

Appreciate the detailed plan and the artifacts — looks straightforward. I'm looping in our commercial lead (Marissa) and promo ops (Ben) to scope an exact credit amount and approval path. A couple quick clarifying questions so we size this conservatively:
- Are you running with KV/prefix caching disabled for a true cold-start soak, or are you doing mixed (cold + warm) phases?
- Do you need dedicated instance routing (to hit latency SLOs) or is hosted with a preferred model variant acceptable?

If you can confirm by EOD Nov 20 we can aim to provision a provisional top-up and lock the window Nov 23 as requested.

—Jonas
Jonas Weber
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com

> Attachment references: edgecraft-poc-plan.pdf, quota_calc.xlsx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 13:22:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Request: burn-in credit supplement for POC latency run

Thanks for the loop — quick internal note and recommended approach:

Summary from EdgeCraft: 6h sustained soak at ~10k RPS, p95 <120ms target. They attached a plan and a rough token calc.

Proposal (conservative):
- Provision a one-time credit supplement of 1.2M token-equivalent as a safety buffer (covers cold-start runs + some replays)
- Extend trial quota for EdgeCraft's org by 72 hours (to allow reruns if telemetry shows anomalies)
- Tag consumption to deal RDW-5421 and set an expiration on the credit (30 days)

Estimated cost impact (back-of-envelope): this is a promotional grant; approve as marketing/sales promo under the POC allowance bucket. I attached a short approval note for finance (approval-note.txt).

Laura — can you sign off on the 1.2M token-supplement? Ben — please flag any quota routing constraints if we should lock them into a dedicated pool or prefer hosted variant with preferential routing.

If approved we should provision before COB Nov 22 to give EdgeCraft time for a dry run.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachments: approval-note.txt

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>

Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 07:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: burn-in credit supplement for POC latency run — APPROVED

All —

Approved. Finance signs off on a one-time promotional credit of 1.2M token-equivalent for EdgeCraft (RDW-5421). Conditions:
- Credit will be active from Nov 22 16:00 UTC through Dec 22 16:00 UTC (30-day expiry)
- Trial quota will be extended by 72 hours beginning Nov 22 00:00 UTC
- Consumption will be tagged to RDW-5421 for reporting; please do not apply across other accounts

Operational notes:
- Ben, please confirm whether we need dedicated pool assignment; if not, ops will provision a soft-priority routing rule for their org to reduce cross-tenant noise during the soak.
- Jonas, please reply-all with the confirmation and the signed DocuSign if EdgeCraft needs a promo agreement. I've cc'd Maya so she has final visibility.

Maya — congrats; you should see the top-up applied and the quota extension on Nov 22. I'll also post the approval in the HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/5421

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Director, Customer Finance, Redwood Inference
